summary.text: Wayne Clark is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 99, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He owns and operates Locust Hill Golf Course.

paragraphs.text: Wayne Clark was born in Baltimore, Maryland, lives in West Virginia, and earned an associate degree from the Community College of Baltimore.
His career experience includes owning and operating Locust Hill Golf Course.
Ballotpedia lists Clark's tenure in the House of Delegates as beginning in 2020, and he has represented District 99 since December 1, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session he was vice chair of the Economic Development Committee, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
